title: [eBay Plus] Gooloo A3/A7 Jump Starter with Air Compressor - $66.39 or 2 for $99.98 Delivered @ Gooloo eBay Store
body:
Deal: [eBay Plus] Gooloo A3/A7 Jump Starter with Air Compressor - $66.39 or 2 for $99.98 Delivered @ Gooloo eBay Store

[Buddy195] 28 to 33psi on car tyres, 45psi on bicycle.
[belesci] Yes it does. 45psi is the same for both a car and bike.
[Flintstone] @belesci: I was wondering that. Weird they spec it like that.
[gumbs] @Flintstone: It will overheat if you try to do a big tyre to 40 psi.
If you did it to 30 psi then waited 20 minutes and did the rest it will be fine.
[belesci] @gumbs: I did 4 flat tyres to 40psi when we went off-roading
[OZKap] @Flintstone: probably can't do flat-45psi in one go for SUV tyre without overheating.
[Kirbieb] How are you getting those prices? And which model?
[Kirbieb] I have ebay plus. I got 2 A3s for 82.98.
Im just not sure what models constitute what prices in the post.
The $66 seems to be for the lowest model but its still 66 for 2 as its buy one get on free at the moment.
[belesci] Just add two and it’s an automatic discount.
[Kirbieb] They emailed me saying it was in error the 2 for 1 deal.
[tyc00n] thought the tyre pump was a novelty but its really super fast because of how fast the motor spins or whatever. Do have a problem where they seem to be overfilled when I check 2 weeks later (33 psi when filled to 32psi) but probably the weather
[SirPumpkinator] Still available for $67.99 with OCT15OFF. Just purchased.
[zukime] Pretty accurate. Tested side by side with the ones at servo and it was reading the same. Takes a little longer than servo ofc but its great unit.
[Plantain] Skip anything GOOLOO. No support when it fails after a few uses.
[Lord Ra] What's a good alternative then please?
@Plantain
@spy
@Naigrabzo
[Naigrabzo] I put my GOO in the LOO .
I never buy GOOLOO.
